name: Cattle and buffalo dairy farms

problems.words: Doodh roz kam aa raha hai, pata nahi kis bhains ka kam hua
quick_ideas: Have milk written per animal for one week, not just the total, so the low yielders show up
Number every thaan so the same animal is always written the same way.

workzap_build.text: nori_daily_read — milkers enter each animal's milk on the phone morning and evening, and every morning the owner automatically sees yesterday's total and which animals dropped below their usual yield.

problems.ask_first: Is milk measured per animal anywhere today, or only the total in the can?
problems.free_stops: How entries are set up per animal and how a "drop" is flagged goes in the solution document.

problems.words: I think milk is being taken before it's measured
quick_ideas: Measure and write the total at one fixed point before any milk leaves the shed
Compare that total with what the buyer says he received, so any gap points to where to look.

workzap_build.text: dashboards_reports — litres milked, sold and used at home are entered at each handover, and the daily gap is calculated automatically and shown to the owner by shift.

problems.ask_first: Does the gap seem worse on a particular shift or day?
problems.free_stops: The handover points and how the gap is tracked by shift are set out in the solution document.

problems.words: The dodhi owes me for two months and keeps saying next week
quick_ideas: Agree the balance with him in writing rather than from memory
Fix a regular settling day so dues can't stretch for months.

workzap_build.text: a ledger for every dodhi, chiller and home customer that adds up litres, rate, fat deductions and payments each day and sends polite WhatsApp reminders on its own.

problems.ask_first: Does he pay against your figures, or only his own notebook?
problems.free_stops: The reminder timing and statement layout stay in the solution document.

problems.words: Wanda prices went up three times and I don't know my cost per litre
quick_ideas: Put one month's feed, fodder, labour, power and vet bills together against litres sold to get a rough cost per litre
Keep each feed delivery's price and date so rises are visible.

workzap_build.text: cost per litre worked out automatically every day from the bills and milk the farm enters, so price rises show the week they happen.

problems.ask_first: Do you grow your own fodder, or is it all bought in?
problems.free_stops: Which costs go in and how they're split is worked out in the solution document.

problems.words: Feed bags come in short, the count never matches
quick_ideas: Count bags off the truck before signing the slip
Do one weekly count of the store so shortages show up quickly.

workzap_build.text: field_checks — bags ordered, received and issued are logged with a photo of the slip, stock left is kept running daily, and a reorder alert goes out automatically.

problems.ask_first: Who signs for feed when it arrives?
problems.free_stops: The store log design and reorder levels are kept for the solution document.

problems.words: We run out of silage in summer and buy at the worst price
quick_ideas: Note when silage ran out last year so you know how early to arrange this year's
Speak to more than one fodder supplier before the season starts.

workzap_build.text: weekly fodder stock entries with an automatic alert showing how many weeks are left at the farm's own usage.

problems.ask_first: Do you make silage on your own land or buy all of it?
problems.free_stops: How weeks-left is worked out from the farm's usage goes in the solution document.

problems.words: I don't know which animals are pregnant or when they're due
quick_ideas: Make one list of every animal with its status (milking, dry, gaaban, heifer)
Write down the dates your vet or AI technician gives you on the day; decisions about the animals stay with your vet.

workzap_build.text: workflow_automation — a herd register on the phone that keeps every status and date the farm enters and sends reminders automatically when an entered due or dry-off date comes up.

problems.ask_first: Who keeps track of insemination dates now?
problems.free_stops: The register fields and reminder rules are set out in the solution document.

problems.words: Calves die and I hear about it days later
quick_ideas: Make it a rule that every birth or death is reported to you the same day with a photo
Call your vet first whenever an animal is unwell; the record is only for the business side.

workzap_build.text: nori_daily_read — an event log for births, deaths, vet visits and their costs that lands in the owner's morning read automatically the same day.

problems.ask_first: Who on the farm is meant to tell you, and how?
problems.free_stops: What gets logged and how it reaches the owner is detailed in the solution document.

problems.words: Milkers leave after Eid and new ones don't know the animals
quick_ideas: Write the daily routine down once, the way you already run it, so a new milker isn't learning from memory
Ask staff early who is going home for Eid so cover is arranged in time.

workzap_build.text: a shift checklist by role with milking times and photo proof, so every new person follows the same routine and missed tasks are flagged each day.

problems.ask_first: How many milkers usually go home around Eid?
problems.free_stops: The checklist itself and how missed items are flagged stay in the solution document.

problems.words: Home delivery customers pay late and the rider keeps the cash too long
quick_ideas: Settle cash with the rider the same evening
Offer bank transfer, JazzCash or Easypaisa to customers who are happy to use them.

workzap_build.text: cash_reconciliation — the rider marks each delivery and payment on the phone, and cash collected vs due is checked automatically every evening.

problems.ask_first: Do customers pay daily, weekly or monthly?
problems.free_stops: The route sheet and evening check are designed in the solution document.

problems.words: Load-shedding stops the chiller and milk goes sour
quick_ideas: Note every power cut and any milk lost, so you know what load-shedding really costs
Agree an earlier pickup with your buyer on bad load-shedding days.

workzap_build.text: dashboards_reports — generator and chiller downtime logged daily with milk lost, totalled automatically for the owner each month.

problems.ask_first: Is there a generator, or does the chiller stop completely?
problems.free_stops: The downtime log and how losses are costed go in the solution document.

never_say: Any medicine, injection, dose, vaccine, withdrawal period, oxytocin use, feed ration or breeding advice; it's always "that's one for your vet".
Anything that helps milk pass a test, hide water or additives, or meet food-authority standards on paper.
Promises that yield, sales or income will rise.
Legal opinions on disputes with a dodhi or partner, or advice on land, loans, subsidies, tax or licensing.
Any way to secretly watch milkers or staff; controls are always open and agreed.

sample_reply.person: Bhai 40 bhainsein hain Landhi mein, doodh har mahine kam ho raha hai aur manager register mein sirf total likhta hai. Koi hal batao.
sample_reply.pi: Ji haan, is ka hal bilkul mumkin hai aur shuruaat isi hafte se ki ja sakti hai. 1) Ek hafte ke liye har bhains ka doodh alag likhwayein, taake kam dene wali saamne aa sakein. 2) Jo doodh bikta hai us ka roz dodhi ki parchi se milaan karein, taake farq ho toh pata chale kahan dekhna hai. Workzap yeh sab aap ke liye khud-ba-khud roz kar sakta hai: milker phone pe har bhains ka doodh darj kare, aur aap ko har subah total aur kam dene wali bhainson ki list mil jaye. Kya main aap ke liye solution document aur quote banwa doon? Mana bhi kar sakte hain.
